Defect: Virtual environment unusable after project folder renamed
Resolution: Deleted; rebuilt venv in the final folder
Preventive control: Never rename or move the project folder after creating the venv
Confirm the activation script exists after building

Defect: Git not installed at project start

Root cause: Filename contained dashes; notebook folder needed ../
Resolution: Listed the folder with os.listdir and used the exact name
Preventive control: List or glob files; never retype names

Defect: Diagonal artefact in DMCC, Gold Souq, Jabal Ali and Mashreq plots
Root cause: Rows unsorted after the rename merge
Resolution: Re-sorted by station and date; master and model-ready files re-saved

Defect: Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall mismatched at three stages: raw label, missing line and coordinates, results key; win counts 46/5/3 instead of 47/4/2
Root cause: Stray space in the label defeated exact-name merges
Resolution: Normalised label; restored fields; re-ran station; re-merged results
Preventive control: Verify keys and row counts after every merge (test T03)

Defect: Geocoding failed for about 75% of station names
Root cause: Nominatim could not resolve the names
Resolution: Switched to OpenStreetMap Overpass; 14 names mapped manually
Preventive control: Check match rate before relying on a geocoder

Defect: Reported trips collapsed about 23 times from May 2024; Sep-Dec 2023 unusable
Root cause: Change in the source's data collection or aggregation
Resolution: Validated against RTA statistics; restricted window to Jan 2018 - Aug 2023
Preventive control: Validate source data against an external reference

Defect: Exhaustive SARIMA search failed at 7 stations
Root cause: NaN gaps in series; AIC candidates lacked diversity
Resolution: Linear interpolation; union of fixed and AIC candidates

Defect: LSTM accuracy varied between runs (BurJuman 9.0% to 25.1%)
Notebook kernel showed NameError and froze after the LSTM run
Root cause: Resource contention after a long run
Preventive control: Restart the kernel before long runs

Root cause: Reloader subprocess failed on a path containing a space; app.run guard missing
../ prefix although the app runs from the project root
Resolution: Removed ../ from model and CSV paths
Preventive control: Build paths from the app's own location
Know which components are created dynamically

Defect: Two model toggles on screen, one dead
Root cause: Four stale python.exe processes serving old code (reloader off)
Resolution: Killed all python.exe; restarted from a fresh terminal
Preventive control: Restart after every edit; check Task Manager

Defect: Map labels clipped and overlapped; EXPO branch drawn diagonally; Al Fahidi and BurJuman at identical coordinates; uneven Green Line spacing
Root cause: Default label positions, margins and initial coordinates
Resolution: Per-station label sides; wider margin with cliponaxis=False; explicit right-angle bend; corrected schematic_positions.json
Preventive control: Set layout explicitly; inspect all stations

Defect: Station labels overlapped on the Green, Red, BurJuman and Route 2020 rows at 1280 px (found by T15)
Root cause: All labels in a horizontal run placed on the same side of the line
Resolution: Alternated top/bottom label positions along each run; moved DMCC to the left of the trunk
Preventive control: Inspect every row of the map at the target width after any layout change

Defect: Forecast not visible at horizon 1; confidence interval drawn as stray markers (found by T16)
Root cause: Single-point forecast trace drawn with mode='lines'; interval trace used default markers
Resolution: Forecast traces use lines+markers; interval shown as error bars at horizon 1 and as a band otherwise
Preventive control: Check horizon limits visually as well as by length (T06 only checked the number of values)
